landing.heroSubtitle: Compare macroeconomic indicators across countries, explore GDP, inflation, and unemployment trends, and get AI-powered chart analysis in seconds.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need for economic analysis.
landing.featuresSubtitle: From raw World Bank data to AI-powered insights — all in one platform.
landing.feat1Desc: Normalize and compare indicators across up to 4 countries on aligned timelines.
landing.feat2Desc: Monitor GDP, GDP per capita, and economic growth rates across countries and decades.
landing.feat3Desc: Generate probabilistic forecasts with confidence bands and backtesting metrics.
landing.feat4Desc: Ask questions about your charts and get concise analytical explanations instantly.
landing.feat5Desc: Full Russian, Kazakh, and English support across all interfaces and labels.
landing.feat6Desc: Download comparison results as CSV for offline processing and reporting.

landing.aiSectionSubtitle: The AI agent reads your current chart output and answers your question in plain language.
landing.howTitle: From data to insight in 3 steps.
landing.step1Desc: Choose countries, indicators, and a time range from the World Bank catalog.
landing.step2Desc: Run the analysis. Explore synchronized charts, correlations, and economic trends across all indicators.
landing.step3Desc: Ask the AI agent questions, generate forecasts, or export results as CSV.
